notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten 4th-of-July notes list Kellogg, 208-786-9131, kelloggcity@kellogg.id.gov, and indicate a June 3 conversation / interest in information. Gmail confirms Adventure Zone sent a 2027 4th-of-July celebration email to the Kellogg city contact. Source: handwritten call notes, page 88; Adventure Zone Gmail.
